composition_subtypes.role: Sort rings by descending outer radius, then inner radius to enable efficient DP
DP with 1D state (dp[i] = max height ending at ring i), optimized via monotonic stack

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort rings by (outer, inner) descending, then DP with monotonic stack to find max tower height.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables non-increasing outer radius condition; stack-based DP efficiently computes max height by reusing only valid previous rings.
